Home.title: Konfeti
Home.subtitle: Invitations people actually want to open.
Home.description:
Replies, chat, who's bringing what, shared pot: it all happens in one place.
No more group chats spiraling out of control.
Home.descriptionNoPot:
Replies, chat, who's bringing what: it all happens in one place.
No more group chats spiraling out of control.
Home.featureChatText: Every event gets its own conversation, with a secret thread to plan surprises.
Home.featureBringText: Everyone ticks off what they're bringing, in real time: never again 8 bags of chips and zero drinks.
Home.featureOverviewText: Date, address, who's coming, who's bringing what: the whole event on a single screen.
Home.screenshotChatAlt: A Konfeti event's chat, with messages and reactions
Home.screenshotBringAlt: The Who's bringing what screen, with claimed-vs-needed gauges
Home.screenshotOverviewAlt: A guest's home screen for a Konfeti event on the day itself, with the address and forecast
Home.installIntro: Konfeti installs straight from your browser, no app store needed: an icon on your home screen, just like a real app.
Home.installAndroidSteps: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu and choose "Install app" (or "Add to Home screen").
Home.installAndroidPlayStore: Or download the app from the Play Store here
Home.installIosSteps: In Safari, tap the Share button and choose "Add to Home Screen".

pot.label: the pot
pot.hintPro: Pro: keeps the amount or goal of the collection a surprise.
pot.hintCon: Con: the guest of honor can't follow or contribute to their own pot.

backstage.label: the Backstage thread
backstage.hintPro: Pro: everyone else can plan the surprise without any risk of it leaking.
backstage.hintCon: Con: none really, that's exactly what this thread is for (planning a surprise without the guest of honor seeing it).

chat.label: the general chat
chat.hintPro: Pro: no risk of anything slipping through messages between the other guests.
chat.hintCon: Con: the guest of honor loses track of the conversation and touch with the group.

bring.label: "who's bringing what"
bring.hintPro: Pro: hides a surprise dish or gift planned by the others.
bring.hintCon: Con: the guest of honor can't organize themselves on this.

polls.label: the polls
polls.hintPro: Pro: hides a poll tied to the surprise (e.g. choosing the cake).
polls.hintCon: Con: the guest of honor can't vote like the other guests.

participants.label: the participant list
participants.hintPro: Pro: hides who's invited and how many people are coming.
participants.hintCon: Con: the guest of honor won't know who'll be there until the day itself.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPolicy.whoBody: Konfeti is a BelgaCai project. This page explains what data we collect when you use Konfeti, why, and what your rights are. For any question, write to konfeti@belgacai.com.
PrivacyPolicy.dataItem1: Identity: first name, last name, gender, avatar (photo or preset image)
PrivacyPolicy.dataItem3: Your replies to an event (I'm coming / maybe / I can't make it), your poll votes
PrivacyPolicy.dataItem5: The messages you send in an event's chat
PrivacyPolicy.dataItem6: If you contribute to a pot: the amount of your contribution. Your bank details are never sent to Konfeti: they're entered directly with our payment provider, Stripe
PrivacyPolicy.dataItem7: Minimal technical information (IP address, error logs) to keep the service running properly
PrivacyPolicy.whyHeading: Why do we collect this data?
PrivacyPolicy.whyItem1: Let you create and join events
PrivacyPolicy.whyItem2: Let the host approve participants and organize their party
PrivacyPolicy.whyItem3: Send you email reminders, only if you've explicitly opted in
PrivacyPolicy.whyItem4: Keep the service secure and diagnose technical issues
PrivacyPolicy.whoSeesBody1: Your phone number, full name and gender are never publicly visible: only the organizers and admins of the event you're taking part in have access to them. Other participants only see your first name, the first letter of your last name, and your avatar.
PrivacyPolicy.whoSeesBody2: We never sell or share your data with third parties for commercial or advertising purposes.
PrivacyPolicy.retentionHeading: How long do we keep your data?
PrivacyPolicy.retentionBody: An event's data (participants, messages, commitments) is automatically deleted about 3 months after the event's date (or after it's cancelled). Your profile (first name, last name, phone) is kept for as long as you use Konfeti, and deleted if you delete your account.
PrivacyPolicy.sharingHeading: Who do we share your data with?
PrivacyPolicy.sharingIntro: We use the following providers to make Konfeti work:
PrivacyPolicy.sharingItem1: Supabase (database, authentication, photo storage), hosted in the European Union
PrivacyPolicy.sharingItem3: Brevo (sending reminder emails, if you've consented to it)
PrivacyPolicy.sharingItem4: Open-Meteo and Komoot Photon (weather and address lookup, with no personal data shared beyond the event's address)
PrivacyPolicy.sharingItem5: Stripe (processing pot payments and paying out funds to the host), as data controller for the bank details it collects itself
PrivacyPolicy.sharingBody: Konfeti never has access to your bank details: only Stripe receives them, directly.
PrivacyPolicy.rightsIntro: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify and delete your data:
PrivacyPolicy.rightsItem1: You can edit your profile directly from the app
PrivacyPolicy.rightsItem2: You can delete your account at any time from your profile
PrivacyPolicy.rightsItem3: For any other request (access, rectification, objection), write to konfeti@belgacai.com
PrivacyPolicy.cookiesBody: Konfeti uses one technical cookie necessary for the service to work. See our Manage cookies page for details.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.objectBody: Konfeti (a BelgaCai project) is a service that lets individuals organize events: invitations, replies, chat, "who's bringing what" organizing, polls and a shared pot. By creating an event or taking part in one, you agree to these terms.
Terms.accountBody: You need to create an account (email or Google) to use Konfeti: reply to an event, chat, organize "who's bringing what" or contribute to a pot. You're responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide.
Terms.rulesItem1: Stay respectful in chat and messages exchanged with other participants
Terms.rulesItem2: Don't post unlawful, abusive content or content that infringes on others' rights
Terms.rulesItem3: Don't use Konfeti to send unsolicited messages (spam)
Terms.rulesItem4: Hosts are responsible for moderating their own event
Terms.rulesBody: Konfeti reserves the right to remove any clearly unlawful content and, in case of repeated abuse, to suspend an account.
Terms.potBody: When a pot is enabled on an event, payments are processed by our provider Stripe and paid directly into the host's bank account, never into a Konfeti account. Konfeti automatically takes a service fee from each contribution, the amount of which is shown before the payment is confirmed. Contributions made are final and can't be refunded through Konfeti, unless stated otherwise at the time of payment. The host remains solely responsible for how the funds raised are used.
Terms.liabilityBody1: Konfeti provides an organizing tool, but is not a party to the events organized by its users. Konfeti can't be held liable for the consequences related to the organizing or running of an event, nor for content published by hosts and guests.
Terms.liabilityBody2: Konfeti strives to keep the service available, without guaranteeing a total absence of interruptions or errors.
Terms.deleteBody: You can delete your account at any time from your profile. This action removes your personal information and makes you leave all your ongoing events.
Terms.changesBody: These terms may change over time. In case of a significant change, we'll let you know through the app.
Terms.contactBody: For any question about these terms, write to konfeti@belgacai.com.

CookieSettings.title: Manage cookies
CookieSettings.whatBody1: Konfeti uses a single cookie, strictly necessary for the service to work: it remembers your session (logged in to your account), for about 12 months. Without it, the app can't recognize you from one visit to the next.
CookieSettings.whatBody2: This technical cookie doesn't require consent under current regulations, as it's essential for the service you explicitly request by using it.
CookieSettings.notItem3: No reselling of browsing data to third parties
CookieSettings.notBody: If Konfeti ever adds an audience measurement tool, we'll favor a solution that doesn't set a cookie and doesn't collect any personally identifiable data; this page will be updated accordingly.
CookieSettings.manageBody: You can delete this cookie at any time from your browser's settings, or directly below. Note that this will log you out of Konfeti.
